conditions: TESU's 2026–2027 catalog equivalency, submitted by the university and published by ACE, lists SOPH-0015 (ENG1001) version 4 as ENC-1010 Writing for Success, 3 semester credits. The receiving course is documented for the catalog, not for one TESU degree.

Provider eligibility remains separate: TESU's Approved Provider Directory lists SOPHIA Learning, LLC as Provisionally Approved – Review Pending, and Sophia's TESU page lists its courses without an established transfer agreement. This documented receiving match is not an unconditional instruction to enroll.
ACE recommends SOPH-0015 version 4 for 3 lower-division semester credits from 2024-04-01 through 2027-03-31; the completed version and date must fall within that period.

ACE notes that actual credit awarded may differ and encourages learners to request a TESU transfer evaluation before enrolling or paying. TESU reserves the right to determine how credit applies to each degree; original learning counts once.
Sophia requires an overall passing course percentage of at least 70. TESU reviews ACE credit from an official Credly transcript, and its own grade rules still apply.
